points.text: The FBI is investigating a suspected breach of its National Crime Information Center, the second recent reported intrusion involving an FBI system.
Mexican forces arrested alleged cartel leader and FBI fugitive El Chapo Isidro in Sinaloa; reports say the operation involved U.S. intelligence cooperation and was followed by violence.
A Russian cargo ship caught fire after a drone strike in the Baltic Sea and drifted into Finnish waters; Finland imposed temporary air and maritime restrictions.
A federal jury convicted Jonathan Rinderknecht of charges related to starting the 2025 Palisades Fire, which killed 12 people and destroyed thousands of structures.
The European Union proposed taxing large digital companies to fund its next long-term budget, whose draft reduces an earlier spending proposal by €204 billion.
